items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: His name was Morris. The guy, his name was Morris. He was one of the benefactors of the American Revolution. He raised the money. He used to own that place.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know that. Later years she became a partner. And he was down here, I worked with them, we used to play in a dance hall down on Elysium Fields. You have to go out on the gallery and play a warm up tune to get the customers to come in. And I don't remember who the hell was playing the piano but I know Vic was playing piano. I don't think we had a bass fiddle. We had a trombone and his father played the carnet. I don't remember who played trombone but these were all adults. And Vic and I, we were still in…
To get back to Lesion Fields, I know it's a little bit on the way. Do you remember the corner about that dance hall?
